# Results — Study 409 (Tweezer Tops & Bottoms) on real daily tape

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). One recipe — detect tweezer
tops & bottoms by exact OHLC rules (two consecutive bars sharing a near-equal extreme,
after a short prior trend leg), enter the **next bar's open**, hold a fixed window, and
read each event's forward return **net of the same tape's unconditional base rate** — run
across a basket of **31 liquid US large-caps + SPY**. As-of **2026-06-23**. Daily bars are
total-return adjusted (`auto_adjust=True`). Panel fingerprint **`0419a25e5aaf`**. Events
pooled across the basket: **n = 6,949** (2,952 bottoms + 3,997 tops; ~22 events/name/year).*

> **Survivorship caveat (Signal axis):** the basket is names *still trading in 2026*. A
> survivor tilt is *bullish*, which would only flatter a reversal-up pattern — and it still
> finds nothing. The caveat travels with the stamp.

## The base-rate confound — where the fake significance lives (raw, gross, hold=5)

| Event | n | win-rate | raw mean (bps) | raw HAC *t* | base rate (bps) |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **Tweezer bottom (long)** | 2,952 | 54.4% | **+26.78** | **+4.16** | +32.35 |
| **Tweezer top (short)** | 3,997 | 44.7% | **−24.69** | **−4.87** | −32.35 |

The bottom's raw HAC *t* = +4.16 looks decisive — but **+26.78 bps undershoots the
+32.35 bps base rate** (the forward return of buying *any* bar). The top's *t* = −4.87 is
the short side losing money on a market that drifts up. **Both raw *t*-stats are the equity
drift, not a pattern effect.** A long candlestick pattern on a rising market is significant
by construction; the only honest frame is excess-over-base-rate (below).

## The honest test — excess over same-tape base rate (gross)

Subtract each tape's signed unconditional forward return event-by-event; one-sample HAC *t*
on the residual.

| Event | 1d excess (*t*) | 3d excess (*t*) | 5d excess (*t*) | 10d excess (*t*) |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **Bottom (long)** | −1.78 (−0.83) | −1.66 (−0.37) | **−0.69 (−0.11)** | +5.18 (+0.52) |
| **Top (short)** | −1.65 (−0.95) | +0.91 (+0.25) | **+3.79 (+0.74)** | +2.66 (+0.34) |

**No horizon, no side clears |*t*| = 2.** The headline +4.16 collapses to −0.11 once the
drift is removed. The tweezer reversal is indistinguishable from noise.

## The date-shuffle placebo — does the *timing* carry information? (signed, hold=5)

Same event count, same long/short mix, **random entry days** (5,000 draws).

| | mean (bps/event) |
|---|--:|
| Real tweezers (signed book) | **−2.82** (HAC *t* = −0.74) |
| Date-shuffle placebo | −4.92 ± 4.63 |
| **placebo *p*(≥ real)** | **0.324** |

And the cleanest version — random *long* days vs the tweezer bottom:

| | mean (bps) |
|---|--:|
| Tweezer bottom (raw) | +26.78 |
| Random long-day placebo | +32.41 ± 7.09 |
| **placebo *p*(≥ real)** | **0.783** |

Random buy-days beat the tweezer bottom **78%** of the time. The matched lows do not single
out informative days.

## Myth-check — does the prior-trend filter rescue it? (excess, hold=5)

| Event | trend-filtered excess (*t*) | no-filter excess (*t*) |
|---|--:|--:|
| Bottom | −0.69 (−0.11) | −5.92 (−1.34) |
| Top | +3.79 (+0.74) | +0.97 (+0.23) |

With the supposed secret-ingredient filter or without it, the excess *t* stays inside ±1.5.
The filter doesn't hide a signal — there isn't one to hide.

## Cost sweep — the only drift-free book (signed market-neutral, hold=5, borrow 50 bps on shorts)

| one-way cost / leg | net mean (bps/event) | HAC *t* |
|---|--:|--:|
| 0.0 bps (gross) | −3.39 | −0.89 |
| 1.0 bps | −5.39 | −1.41 |
| 2.0 bps | −7.39 | −1.93 |
| 5.0 bps | −13.39 | −3.50 |

The market-neutral pairing (long bottoms, short tops) is negative *before* costs; spread on
both legs plus short borrow only deepen it. No positive break-even cost exists.

## Synthetic positive control — the detector works when there's something to find

Plant a genuine post-tweezer reversal into a synthetic panel (`data.synthetic_panel(edge=…)`,
20 names, mean over 5 seeds) and sweep the knob; the same detector reads the signed HAC *t*:

| Planted edge | detected signed HAC *t* | mean (bps) |
|---|--:|--:|
| 0.00 (null) | **+0.25** (noise) | +1.27 |
| 0.02 (real reversal) | **+4.12** (found) | +18.95 |

The engine is faithful: ≈ 0 when nothing is planted, strongly positive when a reversal is.
The real-tape `NONE` is therefore a statement about the **market**, not the method.

## Verdict

- **Signal — NONE.** Base-rate-adjusted, the tweezer bottom adds −0.69 bps (HAC *t* = −0.11)
  and the top +3.79 bps (*t* = +0.74) at 5 days; no horizon clears *t* = 2. The raw +4.16 was
  pure equity drift. *(Survivorship caveat: a survivor basket tilts bullish and still finds
  nothing.)*
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** The only drift-free framing — a market-neutral long-bottom /
  short-top book — is −3.39 bps/event gross and sinks with costs. No break-even cost exists.
- **Two aligned wicks mark the turn? — BUSTED.** Date-shuffle placebo *p* = 0.32; random
  long-days beat the bottom 78% of the time. The matched extremes are a coincidence, not a
  forecast.
